besluite.fout: 'Daar' reads as a place, but no place is named; its antecedent is the court case 'n ander hofsaak', so a Grade 4 reader has to work out what it points to.
besluite.rede: Naming the case makes the reference clear without moving the meaning (he spoke in that 1963 case, in April 1964), touches no protected wording, and links naturally to 'Die saak het nog weke lank geduur'.
